template.name: Template SNMP MeshCore
template.description:
MeshCore LoRa mesh repeater/room-server SNMP monitoring. OID base: 1.3.6.1.4.1.62911.1
Groups 1-4: read-only stats. Groups 5-7: read-write control (requires {$SNMP_RW_COMMUNITY}).
Macros to override per host: {$SNMP_COMMUNITY} - read community (default: public) {$SNMP_PORT} - UDP port (default: 161) {$BATT_WARN_V} - battery warning threshold in V (default: 3.5) {$BATT_CRIT_V} - battery critical threshold in V (default: 3.2) {$NOISE_WARN_DBM} - noise floor warning in dBm (default: -90) {$AIRTIME_WARN_PCT} - airtime utilization warning % (default: 80) {$RX_ERR_DELTA_WARN} - RX errors per 5min before warning (default: 10) {$QUEUE_WARN_LEN} - outbound queue warning length (default: 5) {$BRIDGE_RECONN_WARN}- bridge reconnects per 15min (default: 3)

item.name: Node Name
item.description: Human-readable node name. CLI: set name.

item.name: Firmware Role
item.description: Firmware role: repeater or room_server.

item.name: Firmware Version
item.description: Firmware version string, e.g. v1.16.0.

item.name: Public Key (Hex)
item.description: Node identity public key (64 hex chars = 32 bytes). Uniquely identifies this node on the mesh.

item.name: Uptime
item.description: Time since boot. Raw TimeTicks (hundredths of a second) converted to seconds.

item.name: Battery Voltage
item.description: Battery voltage. Raw Gauge32 in millivolts, displayed as volts. 0 = no battery hardware.

item.name: Total TX Air Time
item.description: Cumulative TX air time since boot. Drives duty-cycle enforcement. Raw Counter32 in ms.

item.name: RX Air Time
item.description: Cumulative RX air time since boot. Raw Counter32 in ms.

item.name: Remaining TX Budget
item.description: Remaining TX duty-cycle budget right now. 0 = node deferring all TX. Raw Gauge32 in ms.

item.name: Noise Floor
item.description: Current noise floor from LoRa transceiver. Less negative = more interference. Typical: -104 dBm.

item.name: Last RSSI
item.description: RSSI of the most recently received LoRa packet.

item.name: Last SNR
item.description: SNR of the most recently received LoRa packet. Decimal ASCII string, unscaled. Negative is normal for LoRa. Example: -1.25

item.name: Duty Cycle Allowance
item.description: Configured TX duty-cycle ceiling as decimal ASCII percent. This is the configured limit, not live utilization. Example: 12.50

item.name: Airtime Utilization
item.description: Live airtime utilization as decimal ASCII percent (0.00-100.00). Self-measuring: airtime consumed since last read / elapsed time * 100. Poll interval = averaging window. First read after boot returns 0.00.

item.name: Packets Sent (Flood)
item.description: Flood (broadcast) packets transmitted since boot.

item.name: Packets Sent (Direct)
item.description: Direct (unicast/routed) packets transmitted since boot.

item.name: Packets Received (Flood)
item.description: Flood packets received and accepted after duplicate filtering.

item.name: Packets Received (Direct)
item.description: Direct packets received and accepted since boot.

item.name: Radio Packets Received (Raw)
item.description: Raw packets received by radio driver before mesh-layer filtering. Includes duplicates, foreign-network packets, and decode failures.

item.name: Radio Packets Sent (Raw)
item.description: Raw packets handed to radio driver for TX since boot.

item.name: Radio RX Errors
item.description: RX errors from radio driver: CRC failures, header errors. Persistently rising = RF interference or misconfigured channel (wrong freq/BW/SF).

item.name: Outbound Queue Length
item.description: Current outbound TX queue depth. Should be near 0. Non-zero = congestion or duty-cycle limiting.

item.name: Error Flags
item.description: Internal error flags bitmask (_err_flags in Dispatcher). 0 = no errors. Correlate with src/Dispatcher.h for the running firmware version.

item.name: Bridge TX Packets
item.description: Packets forwarded mesh to bridge (e.g. published to MQTT) since boot. 0 if no bridge compiled in.

item.name: Bridge RX Packets
item.description: Packets received from bridge and injected into mesh since boot. 0 if no bridge compiled in.

item.name: Bridge Reconnects
item.description: Bridge transport reconnections since boot (e.g. MQTT TCP reconnects). Rapidly rising = unstable broker. 0 if no bridge.

item.name: Config: Radio Frequency
item.description: Radio frequency (decimal ASCII MHz). Example: 869.525. CLI: set freq.

item.name: Config: Radio Bandwidth
item.description: Radio bandwidth (decimal ASCII kHz). Example: 250.000. CLI: set bw.

item.name: Config: Spreading Factor
item.description: Spreading factor (5-12). CLI: set sf.

item.name: Config: Coding Rate
item.description: Coding rate (5-8). CLI: set cr.

item.name: Config: TX Power
item.description: TX power in dBm (1-22). CLI: set txpower.

item.name: Config: RX Boosted Gain
item.description: RX boosted gain. 0=off, 1=on. CLI: set rxboost.

item.name: Config: Repeat Enabled
item.description: Packet repeating enabled. 0=off, 1=on. CLI: set repeat.

item.name: Config: Duty Cycle Limit
item.description: TX duty-cycle ceiling, whole percent 1-100. CLI: set dutycycle.

item.name: Config: TX Delay Factor
item.description: TX delay factor (decimal ASCII, unscaled). Example: 1.50. CLI: set txdelay.

item.name: Config: Direct TX Delay
item.description: Direct TX delay factor (decimal ASCII, unscaled). CLI: set directdelay.

item.name: Config: RX Delay Base
item.description: RX delay base factor (decimal ASCII, unscaled). CLI: set rxdelay.

item.name: Config: Flood Max Hops
item.description: Maximum flood hops (0-64). CLI: set flood.max.

item.name: Config: Flood Max Hops (Unscoped)
item.description: Flood max hops for unscoped packets (0-64; 255=track flood.max). CLI: set flood.max.unscoped.

item.name: Config: Flood Max Hops (Advert)
item.description: Flood max hops for advertisement packets (0-64). CLI: set flood.max.advert.

item.name: Config: Path Hash Mode
item.description: Path hash mode (0-2). CLI: set path.hash.

item.name: Config: Loop Detection Mode
item.description: Loop detection mode: 0=off, 1=minimal, 2=moderate, 3=strict. CLI: set loopdetect.

item.name: Config: Interference Threshold
item.description: Interference detection threshold in dBm. CLI: set interference.

item.name: Config: AGC Reset Interval
item.description: AGC reset interval in seconds (firmware rounds to multiple of 4). CLI: set agc.reset.

item.name: Config: Multi-ACK
item.description: Multiple ACK transmission. 0=off, 1=on. CLI: set multiack.

item.name: Config: Flood Advert Interval
item.description: Flood advertisement interval in hours (0=disabled, or 3-168). CLI: set advert.flood.

item.name: Config: Local Advert Interval
item.description: Local advert interval in minutes (0=disabled, or 60-240, rounded to multiple of 2). CLI: set advert.interval.

item.name: Config: Node Name (writable)
item.description: Node name (read-write). CLI: set name.

item.name: Config: Latitude
item.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (signed ASCII). Example: 51.500000. CLI: set lat.

item.name: Config: Longitude
item.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (signed ASCII). Example: -0.125000. CLI: set lon.

item.name: Config: Owner Info
item.description: Owner/contact info string. Pipe character | = newline. CLI: set owner.

item.name: Config: Allow Read-Only Clients
item.description: Allow unauthenticated read-only access. 0=off, 1=on. room_server only. CLI: set allow.readonly.

item.name: Config: ADC Multiplier
item.description: ADC voltage multiplier (decimal ASCII). 0=board default. Example: 1.702. CLI: set adc.mult.

item.name: Config: Bridge Enabled
item.description: Bridge enabled. 0=off, 1=on. CLI: set bridge.enabled.

item.name: Config: Bridge Delay
item.description: Bridge forwarding delay in ms (0-10000). CLI: set bridge.delay.

item.name: Config: Bridge Source
item.description: Bridge packet source: 0=logTx, 1=logRx. CLI: set bridge.source.

item.name: Config: MQTT Server
item.description: MQTT broker hostname or IP. CLI: set bridge.mqtt.server.

item.name: Config: MQTT Port
item.description: MQTT broker port (0=default 1883). CLI: set bridge.mqtt.port.

item.name: Config: MQTT Topic
item.description: MQTT topic string. CLI: set bridge.mqtt.topic.

item.name: Config: MQTT Username
item.description: MQTT username. CLI: set bridge.mqtt.user.

item.name: Config: MQTT Autostart
item.description: MQTT autostart on boot. 0=off, 1=on. CLI: set bridge.autostart.

trigger.name: Node unreachable: no SNMP response for 10m
trigger.description: No SNMP data received for 10 minutes. Node may be offline or SNMP agent stopped.

trigger.expression: last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.uptime)<600 and last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.uptime)>0
trigger.name: Node rebooted: uptime under 10 minutes
trigger.description: Node uptime is less than 10 minutes, indicating a recent reboot or power cycle.

trigger.expression: last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.batt.v)>0 and last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.batt.v)<{$BATT_CRIT_V}
trigger.name: Battery voltage critical: below {$BATT_CRIT_V} V
trigger.description: Battery voltage is critically low. Node may shut down soon.

trigger.expression: last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.batt.v)>0 and last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.batt.v)<{$BATT_WARN_V}
trigger.name: Battery voltage low: below {$BATT_WARN_V} V

dependency.name: Battery voltage critical: below {$BATT_CRIT_V} V
dependency.expression: last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.batt.v)>0 and last(/Template SNMP MeshCore/meshcore.sysinfo.batt.v)<{$BATT_CRIT_V}

trigger.name: Elevated noise floor: above {$NOISE_WARN_DBM} dBm
trigger.description: Noise floor is elevated, indicating RF interference. May degrade receive sensitivity and link quality.

trigger.name: TX budget exhausted: duty-cycle limit reached
trigger.description: Remaining TX budget is zero. Node is deferring all transmissions. May indicate unusually high traffic load.

trigger.name: High airtime utilization: above {$AIRTIME_WARN_PCT}%
trigger.description: Live airtime utilization is high. Node may approach duty-cycle limit.

trigger.name: Radio RX errors increasing rapidly
trigger.description: Radio RX error count is increasing rapidly. Possible causes: RF interference, channel misconfiguration (wrong freq/BW/SF), or hardware fault.

trigger.name: Non-zero internal error flags
trigger.description: Internal error flags bitmask is non-zero. Correlate with src/Dispatcher.h for the running firmware version for bit definitions.

trigger.name: Outbound TX queue congested: above {$QUEUE_WARN_LEN} packets
trigger.description: Outbound TX queue is building up. Possible congestion or duty-cycle limiting.

trigger.name: Bridge reconnecting frequently
trigger.description: MQTT bridge is reconnecting frequently. Indicates unstable broker connection or network path to broker.

macro.description: Battery low warning threshold in Volts
Noise floor warning threshold in dBm (less negative = more noise)
RX error change per poll before triggering warning
Bridge reconnect change per poll before triggering warning
